tok 1.0 "Account defaulter processing"

pool org "Organisation"
  lane ops "Operations"
    start morning "Weekday morning" timer=P1D
    task backup "Back up the database"
    sub part1 "Process defaulters"
      start s1 "Begin"
      task checkTable "Check the Account Defaulter table for new records"
      xor newRec "New records found?"
      task checkCrm1 "Check the CRM system for new returns"
      xor newRet1 "New returns filed?"
      task register "Register defaulting accounts and customers"
      xor advised "Client codes previously advised?"
      task produce "Produce a table of defaulting accounts"
      task sendAm "Send the table to account management"
      xor merge "Merge"
      end e1 "Part done"
    boundary late1 "2:30 pm passed" on=part1 timer=PT14H30M noninterrupting
    task checkCrm2 "Check the CRM system for new returns"
    xor newRet2 "New returns filed?"
    sub part2 "Reconcile"
      start s2 "Begin"
      task reconcile "Reconcile with the existing account defaulters table"
      end e2 "Reconciled"
    boundary late2 "4:00 pm passed" on=part2 timer=PT16H noninterrupting
    end done "Process completed"
  lane sup "Supervisor"
    task alert "Send an alert to the supervisor"
    task msg "Send a message to the supervisor"
    end alerted "Alert sent"
    end messaged "Message sent"

flow morning -> backup -> part1
flow s1 -> checkTable -> newRec
flow newRec -> register "yes"
flow newRec -> checkCrm1 "no"
flow checkCrm1 -> newRet1

flow register -> advised
flow advised -> produce "no"
flow advised -> merge "yes"
flow produce -> sendAm -> merge -> e1
flow part1 -> checkCrm2 -> newRet2
flow newRet2 -> part2 "yes"
flow newRet2 -> done "no"
flow part2 -> done
flow late1 -> alert -> alerted
flow late2 -> msg -> messaged
